listing.description:
Enjoy ultra-fast 1GB broadband, all-inclusive bills, and your own TV — with no hidden costs, ever.

Stay active in our 24/7 gym, relax in the cinema or games room, and cook up a storm in MasterChef kitchens. Soak up the views from rooftop terraces, or unwind in stylish lounges and meeting rooms.

Your studio is professionally serviced every fortnight, and you'll have free weekly events to connect, unwind, and make new friends.

It's everything you need — and more — under one roof.
